title: SendGrid Webhook Request
description: Array of SendGrid event objects sent via webhook

event.description: Type of event (processed, delivered, bounce, open, click, etc.)

sg_event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event from SendGrid

sendId.description: Internal identifier for the email that was sent

reason.description: Reason for delivery failure (for bounce/dropped events)

ip.description: IP address of the recipient (for open/click events)

url.description: URL that was clicked (for click events)
